import shutil
p=Path('README.md')
s=p.read_text()
changes={
'Both plugins use the OpenAI GitHub connector':'All three plugins use the OpenAI GitHub connector',
'Open the relevant ChatGPT Project -> New chat -> @Project Leader':'Open the relevant ChatGPT Project -> New chat -> @Project Leader + Codex',
}
for old,new in changes.items():
 if s.count(old)!=1: raise RuntimeError('README unexpected anchor '+old)
 s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
for directory in (Path('control/__pycache__'),Path('scripts/__pycache__')):
 if directory.exists():
  if directory.is_symlink() or not directory.is_dir():raise RuntimeError('Unsafe cache path')
  if any(x.is_symlink() or (x.is_file() and x.suffix!='.pyc') for x in directory.rglob('*')):raise RuntimeError('Unexpected cache content')
  shutil.rmtree(directory)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,hashlib,json
expected={
'.agents/plugins/marketplace.json',
'.github/workflows/package-plugins.yml',
'README.md','codex/dual.py',
'plugins/project-leader-codex/plugin.json',
'scripts/package_plugins.py',
'tests/test_audit_p1_regressions.py',
'tests/test_packaging.py',
'codex/tests/test_worker_environment.py',
'plugins/project-leader-codex/.app.json'
}
out=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','-z'])
status=out.decode().split('\0')
names={x[3:] for x in status if x}
assert names==expected,(sorted(names-expected),sorted(expected-names))
print('FILE_COUNT',len(names),'CHANGED_PATHS',','.join(sorted(names)),flush=True)
records=[]
for name in sorted(names):
 p=Path(name)
 assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_size<60000,name
 content=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 records.append({'path':name,'content':content,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()})
payload={'expected_main_sha':'4a5c5ba5876bad079ec4edf401416804c18bc521','branch':'fix/rea-plcodex-audit-20261030','files':records}
print('PUBLISH_PAYLOAD_BEGIN',flush=True)
print(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
print('PUBLISH_PAYLOAD_END',flush=True)
print('REA_EXPORT_OK',len(records),flush=True)
